thread.title: U.S. stock futures sink after Apple cuts sales forecast

author: Mike Murphy
title: U.S. stock futures sink after Apple cuts sales forecast
text:
U.S. stock futures plunged late Wednesday after Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.11% lowered its holiday-quarter sales forecast . Dow Jones Industrial Average futures YMH9, -1.54% were down more than 300 points, or 1.3%, as of 10 p.m. Eastern. S&P 500 futures ESH9, -1.64% were off more than 1.2%, and tech-heavy Nasdaq futures NQH9, -2.74% sank more than 2%. Apple shares dropped nearly 8% in after-hours trading after the Wednesday afternoon announcement, in which the tech giant blamed disappointing sales on weakness in China. The news had broad repercussions across the tech industry, with some of the biggest tech names , such as Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.44% and Netflix Inc. NFLX, +0.00% falling in after-hours trading.
